title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 AliasMode Chain Resolution Work Item
summary: Add bounded AliasMode parsing and in-memory AliasMode chain resolution for RFC 9461 DNS service binding records.
planned_changes:
- Add `DnsServiceBindingAliasRecord` for priority-zero AliasMode RDATA parsing.
- Add named ServiceMode records and an alias-resolution result/status model.
- Add `DnsServiceBindingAliasResolver` to follow local AliasMode owner-to-target chains to ServiceMode records.
- Detect loops, missing targets, maximum-depth exhaustion, compressed target names, non-zero priorities, and AliasMode SvcParams.
- Add requirement-owned positive, negative, and edge tests.
- Update RFC 9461 trace artifacts, generated triage, and the requirement gap ledger.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused RFC 9461 AliasMode requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full local Release solution test before final goal completion.
completion_notes: RFC 9461 now has a trace-owned AliasMode chain-resolution primitive that future DNS response and resolver adapters can consume.
